Intro: Good day, Chef. Hm? What's this? You want me to read it?
This…yes, this is me. Are you curious why I used to work with Lady Svetka? It's not a glamorous tale.
I was one of her scientists, way before the war. She got us rich, leading our research in medicine to sell to those nobles. Svetka treated us well.
We believed in her dream of a better future. When she rose to power, we followed. It took me too long to realize our work wasn't for a greater good.
That pamphlet, may I have it? I am curious what Svetka is putting around these days with my face. It is worrying…
Success: It seems Svetka still holds me in high regard…I'm surprised you still served me with such a level of care despite seeing this. Thank you, Chef.
Fail: It seems Svetka still holds me in high regard…I'm sorry if my background upsets you. I understand why you would feel that way.
Reject: I understand, I will take my leave. My sins should not be forgiven.
